reconcile.note: Gill locates the Davidic bloodline in Mary herself, reading 'fruit of his loins according to the flesh' as fulfilled through her, not Joseph's paternity.

discrepancy.note: Strauss argued the genealogies lose their purpose once Joseph's paternity of Jesus is denied.

quotes.text: The very design of these tables is to prove Jesus to be of the lineage of David through Joseph; but what do they prove, if indeed Joseph was not the father of Jesus?
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined (1846), ch. IV, on Romans 1:3.

sides.snippet: she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit
sides.verseText: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
